messages:
miguel: quick heads-up — ran a cross-GPU attention kernel sweep (fused, paged, flash variants) across A100 / H100 / L40s. seq len sweep 512 -> 32k, batch sizes 1/4/16/64. Observed a sharp latency/throughput regression on H100 for the paged variant around seq ≈ 8k. looks like KV cache is thrashing and kernel selector doesn't fall back. attaching quick notes and logs. :thinking_face:

tara: can you paste the exact run command + env? and which model config (layer count, kv layout)?

miguel: sure — ran from perf bench infra with these options:
```
MODEL=llama-13b
GPUS=h100:1
SEQ_SWEEP="512,2048,8192,16384,32768"
BATCHES="1,4,16,64"
KERNEL_VARIANTS="paged,fused,flash"
./bench_attn.sh --variant paged --seq 8192 --batch 16 --kv-mode paged --prefetch 1 --quant none
```
Logs excerpt (H100, paged, seq=8192, batch=16):
```
[perf] p50=83ms p95=430ms p99=620ms throughput=72t/s cpu-io=12% kv-evictions=0.68
[kv] cache_hits=0.32 cache_misses=0.68 spill_count=18
[kernel] chosen=paged_tile_128x32 fallback_attempts=0
```

perf-bot: AUTO-SUMMARY: H100 paged @8k shows +120ms p95 regression vs flash-fused baseline, throughput -35%. Repro link: <http://perf.internal/runs/1988881234>. Suspect: increased KV eviction rate triggers pathological paged tiling.

alex: this smells like the kernel selector threshold for memory pressure is off. We should: 1) temporarily enable fallback to flash when kv_eviction_rate > 0.4, 2) increase prefetch to 4 and re-run. Also check the tiled kernel tile_size change from 7a9c3f -> 8c2b1e.

miguel: did a quick bisect locally — regression appears after commit `7a9c3f8` (tile tuning patch). KV miss rate jumps at that commit: `0.23 -> 0.68` at seq=8k. Putting the bisect notes here.

sam: I can repro the p95 spike on L40s too but it's ~+40ms vs H100's +120ms — probably fewer hardware caches, but same pattern (kv eviction increases at higher seq).

chris: I'll queue a targeted perf job on the perf-variant pool with toggles: `--kernel-fallback=on`, `--kv-prefetch=4`, and run the kernel-selector in dry-run mode to log candidate scores. queuing now.

miguel: queued jobs: perf-variant-1988881234-a/b (fallback on/off). will link perfbot outputs when done. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: JOB COMPLETE: perf-variant-1988881234-a (fallback=on): H100 paged @8k p95=310ms, throughput +22% vs paged baseline. perf-variant-1988881234-b (fallback=off): p95=428ms. Comparative graphs: <http://perf.internal/comparisons/1988881234>.

tara: great, seems fallback helps. can we make the selector check kv_eviction_rate in the scoring function instead of hard mem thresholds?

alex: agreed — add a cheap probe during first few tokens to estimate kv miss trend and bias selector score. fallback threshold at 0.4 seems reasonable from these runs.

miguel: created a small PR to make selector kv-aware and add an opt-in flag `--selector-kv-safety`. PTAL: https://git.redwood/infra/rep/attn-kernel-selector/pull/342

chris: once merged let's roll to canary on dedicated nodes before gating on prod. I'll coordinate with eng-sre for a canary window.

miguel: thanks all — next steps: 1) land selector kv-safety flag, 2) prod canary on perf-variant, 3) monitor kv-eviction and p95, 4) consider revert of tile tweak if impact persists.

sam: noted. I'll add a small eval that sweeps seq=6k..12k nightly to catch regression early.

perf-bot: TAGS: regression bisect, h100, kv-eviction, kernel-selector, paged-attn, follow-up: PR-342

chris: :rocket:
